verdict.rationale: The evidence shows static code snippets (e.g. a ToolLoopAgent example), a queryable models endpoint, and a Vercel-wide openapi.json. None of these is an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it-in-browser examples for AI Gateway. An OpenAPI spec is a building block someone could use to generate such a reference, and static snippets are not interactive, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
